title: In the Aliro access control reference applications of the Nordic Semiconductor nRF Door Lock and Access Control Add-on…
description: A vulnerability in the Aliro access control reference applications of the Nordic Semiconductor nRF Door Lock and Access Control Add-on versions 1.0.0 through 1.1.1 allows an attacker with a previously valid time-limited credential to continue accessing the system after the credential's expiration. This occurs because the stored Access Document record does not retain the validity period, causing the system to rely on cached keys without re-evaluating expiration. The issue is fixed in version 1.2.0.
